desc: Compute prefix sums `P` (nums) and `C` (cost) of length n+1.
For `g` from 1 to n, run divide-and-conquer on `dp_cur[1..n]` using `dp_prev` and cost `(P[i]-P[j]+k*g)*(C[i]-C[j])`, exploiting monotonic opt.
Track `answer = min(answer, dp_cur[n])` after each g; return `answer`.

Implement D&C recursion: at midpoint `mid`, try all `j ∈ [optL, min(optR, mid-1)]` evaluating `dp_prev[j] + (P[mid]-P[j] + k*g)*(C[mid]-C[j])`; recurse left with `optR = best_k`, right with `optL = best_k`.
Wrap in `class Solution: def minimumCost(self, nums: List[int], cost: List[int], k: int) -> int` with `from typing import List` and large `INF` (e.g. 10**30).
Sanity-check on the two provided examples after writing.
